control.title: Unsuccessful Logon Attempts (account lockout)
control.requirement: Enforce a limit of no more than 10 consecutive invalid logon attempts by a user during any 60-minute period; automatically lock the account/node for at least 15 minutes when the maximum is exceeded.

findings.message: Authentication present but no account-lockout mechanism (10 attempts / 60 min, lock >=15 min) detected.
findings.remediation: Enforce >=10 invalid attempts per 60 min then lock >=15 min on the authentication path.
